name: NCAA D-I Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Ames, IA · host Iowa State · Iowa State Cross Country Course
headline: NCAA D-I Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 3 Oklahoma State, No. 10 Iowa State, No. 22 Minnesota, No. 26 Missouri and No. 30 Tulsa. Women: No. 8 Oklahoma State, No. 20 Missouri, No. 25 Iowa State and No. 28 Minnesota. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K 11:00 a.m. CT · Men 10K 12:00 p.m. CT
